verdict.rationale: Postman's docs explicitly confirm pre-request and post-response scripting to add dynamic behavior, pass data between requests, and chain/massage data ([postman-docs-12], [postman-docs-17]), which directly matches the story. This is corroborated by CI/CD integration via Postman CLI ([postman-docs-19], [postman-docs-6]) for running these scripted collections in pipelines. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of scripting behavior specifically (only official docs cited, no community/dev corroboration of scripting itself).
